lines.0: Namaste Arjun, main Asha, aapki AI teacher hoon. Aaj Factorisation karenge. Maths mein aapko sabse mazedaar game kaunsa lagta hai?

lines.5: Bilkul. Ab 5 aur minus 3 ko x ke saath brackets mein rakhiye: pehla bracket kya hoga?
lines.6: Pehla bracket x plus 5 hai. Doosre number minus 3 se doosra bracket banaiye—poora factorisation kya hoga?
lines.7: Yahan brackets multiply honge, plus nahi likhenge. Ab agle card mein naya example dekhiye. x² + 5x + 6 ka factorisation kariye.
lines.8: Is step mein 5 aur 1 ka product 5 hota hai, 6 nahi. Do numbers dobara chuniye jo product 6 aur sum 5 dein. x² + 5x + 6 ka factorisation kariye.
lines.9: Aapne 2 aur 3 sahi chune. Lekin x² ka coefficient 1 hai, isliye brackets mein x ke aage 2 nahi aayega. x² + 5x + 6 ka factorisation kariye.
lines.10: Aapne jo likha, usmein pehle bracket ke andar 2 aa gaya tha. Chaliye, ab agla card dekhiye. x² − x − 6 ka factorisation kariye.
lines.11: Yahan sign check toota: negative product chahiye, kyunki constant −6 hai. Do numbers chuniye jinka product −6 aur sum −1 ho.
lines.12: Aapne numbers choose karne wala step clearly kiya: product aur sum dono conditions check ki. Ab in numbers se factors banane ka step kijiye. x² − x − 6 ka facto
lines.13: Aapne factors (x − 3) aur (x + 2) kyun chune—expand karne par kaunse sum aur product milte hain?
lines.14: Bilkul sahi: expansion mein 2x aur −3x milkar −x, aur constant −6 aaya. x² − 7x + 12 ka factorisation kariye.
